answer: Ask the applicant to show something a script cannot print on demand: a history that predates this epoch by years. Vehicle title history with motor registry attestation supplies exactly that, in the form of a title held for years and logged in the motor registry. The kernel of the gate is the date on the first entry — it was written before any reward existed. Faking one means inventing a decade; faking a hundred means inventing a century of paper, and the sable in every page is a clerk who remembers stamping it. The harbor is the verifier's arithmetic: dates add up, or the door stays shut.
